timing_context: Uncompressed graph and an empty library; process caches may be warm after source verification; preview 384x144; verdict 192x128.
exposed_controls_note: US size is deliberately not exposed. Every painted layer is one tile over the whole (theta, v) chart and every stamp stands at a chart point, both measured off the 020 escutcheon at an 18.6 mm bore. The factory head keeps its size when the band resizes, so the table then covers a different span of theta: the painted serpent, pits and bordure would slide and stretch across it and the stamps would lose their frames. A size run re-authors the example at the new bore (base() takes the size), which repaints the atlas and restrikes the stamps.
